tierKey: 1 Common Ball, 2 Playlist Pick, 3 Heads Know, 4 Deep Cut, 5 Vault, 6 Day One

questions.p: Name a Raider Klan member (past or present)
questions.f: SpaceGhostPurrp founded Raider Klan in Carol City, Miami in 2008.

questions.p: Name a member of Yung Lean's Sad Boys / Drain Gang orbit
questions.f: Yung Lean's "Ginseng Strip 2002" went viral in 2013.

questions.p: Name a member of GothBoiClique
questions.f: GothBoiClique blended emo and witch house into rap and helped birth emo rap.

questions.p: Name an early-2010s internet rap collective
questions.f: Odd Future played Raider Klan and Lil B songs before taking the stage.
a: odd future wolf gang kill them all

questions.p: Name an artist associated with early-2010s cloud rap
questions.f: The term "cloud rap" was coined in a 2010 blog post about Main Attrakionz's Squadda B.

questions.p: Name a Lil B project (or his most famous alias)
questions.f: Danny Brown called Lil B "the David Bowie of hip-hop."

questions.p: Name a Chief Keef song or project
questions.f: Chief Keef's slurred, lo-fi early catalog fed straight into the SoundCloud generation.

questions.p: Name a member of the 2016 XXL Freshman Class
questions.f: The 2016 class pushed the SoundCloud wave into the mainstream.

questions.p: Name a rapper from the 2016-17 SoundCloud wave
questions.f: Smokepurpp's "Big Bucks" and Lil Pump's "Molly" racked up millions of SoundCloud plays before any label got involved.

questions.p: Name a Lil Peep song or project
questions.f: Lil Peep dropped "Star Shopping" in 2015 and Hellboy in 2016. He died Nov 15, 2017.
a: come over when youre sober pt 1

questions.p: Name an XXXTentacion song or project
questions.f: "Look At Me!" was a SoundCloud hit before peaking at #34 on the Hot 100.

questions.p: Name a Playboi Carti song from before Die Lit (2018)
questions.f: Carti's self-titled tape arrived in April 2017 at the height of the SoundCloud era.

questions.p: Name a Lil Uzi Vert mixtape from before Eternal Atake
questions.f: Uzi's Luv Is Rage 2 debuted at #1. SpaceGhostPurrp produced early Uzi tracks.
a: Lil Uzi Vert vs. the World
lil uzi vert vs the world

questions.p: Name a SoundCloud-born rapper who later had a #1 album on the Billboard 200
questions.f: Ken Carson's More Chaos debuted at #1 in April 2025.

questions.p: Name a rapper with a $ in their name
questions.f: Before the rebrand, Ken Carson went by Ken Car$on.

questions.p: Name a SlayWorld member
questions.f: SlayWorld started as a skatewear brand by Kaine Carlson before becoming pluggnb's epicenter.

questions.p: Name an Autumn! project
questions.f: Autumn! (formerly TrapGodBenji) started rapping after meeting Summrs online, back when Summrs went by LouisVeeDee.
a: dont forget me im still here

questions.p: Name a Summrs project
questions.f: Summrs is often called the king of pluggnb. His 2018 run included DEVOTION, ##Bellworld and Revived.

questions.p: Name a Ka$hdami song or project
questions.f: Ka$hdami was the first rapper to stream with iShowSpeed.

questions.p: Name an artist who appears on Ka$hdami's epiphany (2021)
questions.f: epiphany debuted at #9 on Spotify's US album chart.

questions.p: Name a pluggnb artist
questions.f: The term blends plugg (sparse trap) with R&B chords and melodies.

questions.p: Name a plugg or pluggnb producer
questions.f: MexikoDro and BeatPluggz built plugg's SoundCloud following in the early 2010s.

questions.p: Name a SoFaygo song or project
questions.f: In July 2022, SoundCloud itself promoted a 10-song SoFaygo "leak" pack, later released as BABYJACK.

questions.p: Name a track or tape Autumn! and Summrs made together
questions.f: Autumn! and Summrs are both from Lafayette, Louisiana.

questions.p: Name a Ken Carson album or EP
questions.f: Ken Carson was the first artist signed to Opium (2019).

questions.p: Name an artist on (or affiliated with) Opium
questions.f: Opium signed Homixide Gang in 2021 and debuted Destroy Lonely's "NOSTYLIST" in 2022.

questions.p: Name a Destroy Lonely project
questions.f: If Looks Could Kill dropped May 5, 2023, with Ken Carson on "Money & Sex."

questions.p: Name a Homixide Gang project
questions.f: Homixide Lifestyle 2 (Aug 2025) charted at #91.

questions.p: Name a producer behind the Opium / rage sound
questions.f: Outtatown and Star Boy produced Ken Carson's first big hit, "Yale."

questions.p: Name a song from Whole Lotta Red
questions.f: Ken Carson's Teen X was recorded between WLR sessions.
a: i love u i hate u

questions.p: Name a rage-era underground rapper (2020-23)
questions.f: Rage was defined by bass-heavy 808s, screamed Auto-Tune and big synths.

questions.p: Name a Yeat song or project
questions.f: Yeat came up in SlayWorld alongside Summrs and Autumn!

questions.p: Name an OsamaSon project
questions.f: OsamaSon first made music under the name PradaUMari in 2020.

questions.p: Name an OsamaSon song
questions.f: BruceDropEmOff playing "Cts-V" on stream helped OsamaSon break out.
a: Ik What You Did Last Summer
i know what you did last summer

questions.p: Name an artist OsamaSon has collaborated with
questions.f: OsamaSon rarely does features, which makes each one a big deal.

questions.p: Name a Nettspend song or project
questions.f: Nettspend is from Richmond, Virginia, and played Rolling Loud California in 2024.

questions.p: Name a Che song or project
questions.f: Che's Sayso Says (2024) was widely called one of the best underground albums of the decade.

questions.p: Name an Atlanta underground rapper
questions.f: Glokk40Spaz dropped four projects in 2024 after coming home that summer.

questions.p: Name a Xaviersobased song or project
questions.f: Xaviersobased is from Morningside Heights, NYC, and is a face of the jerk sound.

questions.p: Name a rapper from the current (2024-26) underground
questions.f: Nettspend, OsamaSon and Che were called the underground's big three in 2025.

questions.p: Name a 2slimey project
questions.f: If you thought Che was extreme, 2slimey turns it up further.

questions.p: Name a 2025 underground album or mixtape
questions.f: Critics grouped 2025's most extreme rage under the name "Axxcelerationism."

questions.p: Name a 2026 underground release
questions.f: Nettspend's debut album Early Life Crisis dropped March 6, 2026.
